anthropic-sonnet-5.5.label: Claude Sonnet 5.5
anthropic-sonnet-5.5.note: Read is 0.05x base for Sonnet 5.5 per the page footnote. Hits refresh the TTL at no extra cost (prompt caching docs).

anthropic-sonnet-4.6.label: Claude Sonnet 4.6
anthropic-sonnet-4.6.note: The standard multipliers: 1.25x write (5m), 2x write (1h), 0.1x read.

openai-gpt-5.5.label: OpenAI gpt-5.5
openai-gpt-5.5.note: Earlier models: no cache-write charge; entries typically stay active 5 to 10 minutes of inactivity, up to one hour (prompt caching guide). The simulation uses 5 minutes as the pessimistic end. Automatic, no TTL choice: the 60 minute column is not an option here and is skipped.

openai-gpt-6.1-sol.label: OpenAI gpt-6.1-sol
openai-gpt-6.1-sol.note: GPT-5.6 and later: default writes cost 1.25x and last at least 30 minutes; 12-hour writes cost 2.5x (Responses API). Whether a read extends the 30 minutes is not stated; the simulation assumes it does.

gemini.label: Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview (explicit caching, prompts up to 200k)
gemini.note: Storage is billed per million cached tokens per hour. The caching docs page did not state a default TTL or whether hits refresh it, so Gemini is break-even only, not simulated.
